{{Top|leg}}
'''Kilburn''' was an independent [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who was part of a growing faction who doubted that [[Pilot droid/Legends|pilot droids]], such as the [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] [[V1 pilot droid|V1]] and [[V6-series pilot droid|V6]], would ever be able to fully replace a living [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. In fact, Kilburn refused to ever fly with, or allow, a droid pilot.
